title: Number bases
description:
The same number can be written in different bases. Define four `int` variables using the literal style named in each comment, then print them. Printed normally they all come out in decimal:

```
255
10
8
1000000
```
hints: Hex digits go 0-9 then A-F, so `FF` is 15 × 16 + 15 = 255. In binary, `1010` is 8 + 2 = 10. In octal, `10` is one eight.
rules: Write one million with digit separators (`1'000'000`).
